title: Outlook: remember whether the online archive is expanded or collapsed in the folder pane
summary: The roadmap description and documented archive controls are supported. Hold the briefing because its licensing notes incorrectly say Exchange Online Plan 1, Business Basic, Business Standard and Office 365 E1 users need an archiving add-on to have an online archive; Microsoft documents a 50 GB archive with those plans.
